title: 曾文水庫大壩~Tsengwen Dam
focus: 串聯灌溉調蓄與土石壩滲排水~Serial irrigation storage and embankment drainage
summary: 曾文案例將土石壩內的有效應力及排水，連到下游串聯水庫、灌溉渠道與水能利用。學生把閘門出流、消能功率與泥砂質量分開記帳，再核對渠道容量、田間需水及壩頂沉陷趨勢。全課以假想資料檢驗物理關係，避免把容量相加當成可以任意調度的同一水池。~The Tsengwen case links effective stress and drainage inside an embankment to downstream serial storage, irrigation canals and energy recovery. Learners keep gate discharge, dissipated power and sediment mass in separate accounts before checking canal capacity, field demand and settlement trends. Hypothetical data test physical relationships without treating two reservoir capacities as one freely interchangeable pool.
history: 南區水資源分署現行工程資料列出曾文土石壩高度一百三十四公尺、壩頂長四百公尺；歷史頁記載一九七三年十月三十一日完工。教材採此一百三十四公尺值，沒有混用部分舊資料的一百三十三公尺。與烏山頭的串聯功能提供水量分區背景，假想放流與渠道條件不代表運用規則。墾務局滲流章索引日期是文獻年代。南化的比較案例則說明灌溉多目標與公共原水供應問題各有不同限制。~The current southern authority overview lists a 134 m embankment height and 400 m crest length, while its history records completion on 31 October 1973. This course uses 134 m without mixing the 133 m value in some older accounts. Serial use with Wushantou supplies the water-accounting context; assumed releases and canal conditions are not operating rules. The Reclamation seepage date is bibliographic. Comparison with Nanhua highlights distinct constraints in multipurpose irrigation storage and public raw-water supply.
example: 假想曾文上游水池每天流入一百二十萬立方公尺，輸往下游八十萬、其他損失十萬，蓄量增加三十萬立方公尺。下游接收八十萬，灌溉取走七十萬、損失五萬，增加五萬；全系統增加三十五萬，內部轉水應互相抵銷。若下游需求增百分之二十到八十四萬，下游轉成減少九萬而全系統只增二十一萬。另以六百毫米淨灌溉水深、兩百公頃及效率零點七五求得毛需水一百六十萬立方公尺，不可把效率損失重複扣算。 核驗：Vin=1200000 m3/day; demand=700000 m3/day; lossUpper=100000 m3/day; lossLower=50000 m3/day; dVsystem=Vin-demand-lossUpper-lossLower=350000 m3/day。先各寫一份水量表，再把上游轉出與下游收到配對相消；若旅行時間跨日，需在輸水段另列暫存。以兩池水位庫容變化獨立核對，避免只因合計帳平衡就忽略某一池資料錯誤。~Assume the upper reservoir receives 1.2 million m3 per day, transfers 0.8 million and loses 0.1 million; storage rises by 0.3 million m3. The lower pool receives that transfer, supplies 0.7 million and loses 0.05 million, gaining 0.05 million. System storage therefore rises by 0.35 million, with the internal transfer cancelling. Raising lower demand twenty percent to 0.84 million makes its change negative 0.09 million and the system gain 0.21 million. Separately, a 600 mm net depth over 200 ha at efficiency 0.75 requires 1.6 million m3 gross supply. Verification: Write separate balances and cancel matched upper exports and lower receipts. If travel crosses the daily boundary, include storage in the conveyance segment. Independently compare both pool level-volume changes so a balanced total does not conceal an error in one reservoir.

units.anchor: 串聯水庫的內部轉水~Internal transfers in serial reservoirs
units.title: 串聯水庫的內部轉水~Internal transfers in serial reservoirs
units.mechanism: 曾文與烏山頭的串聯背景提醒水量帳必須選好邊界：對上游水庫而言轉送是流出，對下游是流入，但對合併系統而言它只是內部交換。分池蓄量仍很重要，因為下游需求不能無視輸水能力與旅行時間。兩池總量增加不代表每池都增加，更不表示水可以立即任意調往任何位置。~Serial storage requires explicit boundaries: a transfer leaves the upper reservoir and enters the lower one, but cancels within the combined system. Individual storage still matters because downstream demand is constrained by conveyance capacity and travel time. A rise in combined storage does not imply that both pools rise, nor that water can move instantly and freely to any location where demand occurs.
units.model: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Vin=1200000 m3/day; demand=700000 m3/day; lossUpper=100000 m3/day; lossLower=50000 m3/day; dVsystem=Vin-demand-lossUpper-lossLower=350000 m3/day。適用邊界：同一日封閉雙池系統，內部轉水抵銷，沒有額外下游天然入流。~Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Vin=1200000 m3/day; demand=700000 m3/day; lossUpper=100000 m3/day; lossLower=50000 m3/day; dVsystem=Vin-demand-lossUpper-lossLower=350000 m3/day. Applicable boundary: A two-pool daily system with internal transfers cancelling and no additional natural inflow to the lower pool.
units.verify: 先各寫一份水量表，再把上游轉出與下游收到配對相消；若旅行時間跨日，需在輸水段另列暫存。以兩池水位庫容變化獨立核對，避免只因合計帳平衡就忽略某一池資料錯誤。~Write separate balances and cancel matched upper exports and lower receipts. If travel crosses the daily boundary, include storage in the conveyance segment. Independently compare both pool level-volume changes so a balanced total does not conceal an error in one reservoir.
units.failure: 把內部轉水當成系統新供水會虛增資源；只檢查總蓄量而忽略分池庫存，可能掩蓋下游已接近不足、上游卻有水但無法及時輸送的空間限制。~Counting an internal transfer as new system supply inflates resources. Checking only combined storage can hide a lower-pool shortage while water remains upstream but cannot be conveyed quickly enough to meet demand.
units.misconception: 上下游間轉水會增加兩池合計的新水資源~Transfer between the two reservoirs creates additional combined water resources
units.practice: 將下游需求增加百分之二十，重新求系統與各池蓄量差，再指定內部轉水八十萬立方公尺每天，證明總帳不因轉水名稱而改變。~Increase downstream demand twenty percent and calculate system and individual changes using a transfer of eight hundred thousand cubic metres per day. Show that relabeling internal transfer cannot alter the combined balance.

units.anchor: 壩體孔壓與有效應力~Embankment pore pressure and effective stress
units.title: 壩體孔壓與有效應力~Embankment pore pressure and effective stress
units.mechanism: 土石壩顆粒骨架承擔有效應力，水的孔隙壓力則分擔總法向應力。以總應力減孔壓可說明排水與蓄水變化如何影響骨架受力，但這是單點應力關係，不直接等於整體抗滑能力。若土未飽和或有明顯各向異性，還需要更適當的有效應力描述與材料參數，不能把飽和模型無條件外推。~The soil skeleton carries effective stress while pore water contributes to total normal stress. Subtracting pore pressure illustrates how drainage and reservoir changes affect skeleton loading, but this point relation does not establish whole-slope resistance. Unsaturated conditions or pronounced anisotropy require additional constitutive description and material parameters, so the saturated model cannot be extended indiscriminately to every location or stage of embankment response.
units.model: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：sigmaTotal=420 kPa; u=170 kPa; sigmaEff=sigmaTotal-u=250 kPa。適用邊界：飽和土單一法向分量，壓應力為正，未計剪應力或安全係數。~Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: sigmaTotal=420 kPa; u=170 kPa; sigmaEff=sigmaTotal-u=250 kPa. Applicable boundary: One normal component in saturated soil with compression positive, excluding shear stress and a safety factor.
units.verify: 核對土壓計與測壓管是否代表同一位置、方向與時段，再比較水位升降時兩者變化。將量測高程與水壓基準寫清楚，並以多點剖面辨識局部孔壓，避免把一個平均值套到整個壩坡。~Confirm that earth-pressure and pore-pressure measurements represent matching location, direction and time, then compare their changes during level cycles. Record elevation and pressure datum and use multiple points to identify local conditions rather than assigning one average to an entire slope.
units.failure: 把孔壓當作額外壓緊土粒的力而相加，會把有效應力方向算反；排水堵塞時總應力可能近似不變而骨架有效應力下降，僅看總壓力會漏掉變化。~Adding pore pressure as extra particle clamping reverses the effective-stress relation. During drainage blockage, total stress may stay almost unchanged while skeleton stress falls, so total-pressure observations alone can miss the important change.
units.misconception: 孔隙水壓越高就一定讓土粒骨架承受更大壓應力~Higher pore pressure necessarily increases compression carried by the soil skeleton
units.practice: 固定總應力，把孔壓提高五十千帕後重算，再畫總應力、孔壓與有效應力三條示意線，說明若總應力也變動時為何不能只看水壓。~Hold total stress fixed and raise pore pressure fifty kilopascals, then sketch total, pore and effective stress. Explain why pressure alone is insufficient when total stress changes at the same time.

units.anchor: 排水層的導水阻力~Hydraulic resistance of a drain layer
units.title: 排水層的導水阻力~Hydraulic resistance of a drain layer
units.mechanism: 下游排水層提供較低阻力通路，讓穿過心層的水離開並降低孔壓。達西式可由流量反推所需水頭損失，顯示濾料堵塞或有效面積縮小會提高上游水頭。導水良好與保土功能是兩個要求，材料粗化雖能降低阻力，卻不一定維持對細料的截留，不能只追求最大流量。~A downstream drain offers a lower-resistance path for seepage and helps limit pore pressure. Rearranging Darcy's relation gives the head loss required to pass a flow, showing why clogging or reduced effective area increases upstream head. Hydraulic capacity and soil retention are separate requirements: coarser material may reduce resistance without retaining fines, so maximizing flow alone does not define a satisfactory filter-drain system.
units.model: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Q=0.006 m3/s; L=12 m; k=0.003 m/s; A=24 m2; dh=Q L/(k A)=1 m。適用邊界：均勻飽和達西流、固定有效截面，不代表現地排水層能力驗收。~Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Q=0.006 m3/s; L=12 m; k=0.003 m/s; A=24 m2; dh=Q L/(k A)=1 m. Applicable boundary: Uniform saturated Darcy flow through fixed effective area, not a field drain-capacity acceptance test.
units.verify: 以排水層前後的測壓差與總排水量反算導水能力，確認出口未被回水淹沒。將維護清理、細料出現與降雨時段一起標記，再檢查水頭升高是來水增加還是阻力增加，不能只看流量。~Infer conductance from head difference and total drainage while checking for outlet submergence. Mark cleaning, observed fines and rainfall periods, then determine whether rising head reflects increased inflow or increased resistance rather than interpreting discharge alone.
units.failure: 出口回水會改變水頭邊界，若仍把出口當零壓就錯估阻力；局部堵塞也可能讓水改走旁路，使總排水量近似不變卻在壩內形成不同孔壓分布。~Outlet backwater changes the hydraulic boundary, so assuming zero outlet pressure misestimates resistance. Local blockage can redirect flow through bypasses, leaving total drainage similar while changing the internal pore-pressure distribution.
units.misconception: 總排水量不變就能證明排水層各處都沒有堵塞~Unchanged total drainage proves that no part of the drain is blocked
units.practice: 把滲透係數減半並保持流量不變，重算所需水頭差，再把截面也減少四分之一，比較兩種劣化疊加的效果與量測所需證據。~Halve permeability at fixed flow and recalculate required head difference, then also reduce area by one quarter. Compare the combined effects and identify measurements needed to distinguish the two deterioration mechanisms.

units.anchor: 假想閘下出流量~Hypothetical gated underflow
units.title: 假想閘下出流量~Hypothetical gated underflow
units.mechanism: 閘下出流把上游水頭轉成高速水流，開口面積與局部收縮共同控制通量。用孔口形式可作量級比較，但真實閘門出流還要分自由與淹沒狀態，並知道上游能量與尾水。曾文案例的教學參數完全是假想，不是現地閘門開度表，計算目的是理解水頭平方根與開口面積的一次關係。~Gated underflow converts upstream head into high-speed flow, with opening area and contraction controlling discharge. An orifice-style relation supports scale comparison, but actual gates require distinction between free and submerged conditions and knowledge of upstream energy and tailwater. All parameters here are hypothetical rather than a Tsengwen gate schedule; the purpose is to distinguish square-root head dependence from linear dependence on opening area.
units.model: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Cd=0.65; b=4 m; opening=0.8 m; g=9.81 m/s2; H=9 m; Q=Cd b opening sqrt(2gH)=27.63975 m3/s。適用邊界：假想矩形自由出流開口，水頭以開口中心計，未計尾水淹沒。~Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Cd=0.65; b=4 m; opening=0.8 m; g=9.81 m/s2; H=9 m; Q=Cd b opening sqrt(2gH)=27.63975 m3/s. Applicable boundary: A hypothetical rectangular free-discharge opening with head measured to its center and no tailwater submergence.
units.verify: 畫出開口中心與自由水面，核對水頭定義後用量水設施求實際係數。比較不同開度的係數是否穩定，記錄尾水變化和水面波動，再決定簡單孔口式是否足以描述該測試區間。~Draw opening center and free surface, verify the head definition and infer discharge coefficient from measurements. Compare coefficients across openings while recording tailwater and surface fluctuations before deciding whether a simple orifice relation describes the tested range.
units.failure: 把開口高度改變造成的中心高程變化完全忽略，會使大幅開度比較不一致；尾水淹沒後仍使用自由出流式，則可能高估通量並錯配下游水量帳。~Ignoring the changing opening-center elevation can make comparisons inconsistent over large opening changes. Retaining a free-discharge equation after submergence can overstate flow and distort the downstream water balance.
units.misconception: 不論尾水多高都可以使用相同自由出流公式~The same free-discharge equation applies regardless of tailwater level
units.practice: 將假想開口高度減半但暫維持中心水頭，求流量變化，再重新加入中心位置改變，說明分步比較有助於分辨面積與水頭兩種效應。~Halve opening height while temporarily holding center head fixed, then account for the changed center elevation. Explain how the two-step comparison separates area effects from the effect of altered hydraulic head.

units.anchor: 消能區的功率通量~Power flux in a dissipating reach
units.title: 消能區的功率通量~Power flux in a dissipating reach
units.mechanism: 溢流水失去的水頭代表機械能轉為紊流、熱與聲等形式，流量乘水頭損失可求耗散功率。把功率除以示意面積得到平均面功率通量，有助比較能量集中程度，但單位不是壓力，不能直接當作混凝土或岩盤承受的力。局部沖刷還取決於流向、脈動、材料與持續時間。~Head lost by spill flow represents mechanical energy converted to turbulence, heat and sound. Discharge times head loss gives dissipated power, and dividing by an illustrative area gives mean areal power flux. This compares energy concentration but is not pressure or a structural force. Local scour additionally depends on flow direction, fluctuations, material resistance and duration, so equal mean flux does not imply equal damage.
units.model: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=35 m3/s; dH=18 m; A=140 m2; flux=rho g Q dH/A/1000=44.145 kW/m2。適用邊界：耗散能量在假想面積上的平均分配，不是局部衝擊壓力或沖刷深度。~Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=35 m3/s; dH=18 m; A=140 m2; flux=rho g Q dH/A/1000=44.145 kW/m2. Applicable boundary: Mean dissipated power over a hypothetical area, not local impact pressure or scour depth.
units.verify: 先以總功率核對流量與水頭損失，再確認除以面積後單位仍含每秒能量。比較水槽中的流態與壓力脈動量測，將面功率圖與沖刷地形分開呈現，避免以同一色階暗示兩者一一對應。~Check total power from flow and head loss, then retain the energy-per-time unit after division by area. Compare flume flow patterns and pressure fluctuations, presenting power-flux and scour maps separately rather than suggesting a one-to-one relationship through shared coloring.
units.failure: 把千瓦每平方公尺誤寫成千帕會混淆能量速率與受力；平均分散範圍即使很大，局部射流仍可能集中撞擊，因此均值低不能排除局部侵蝕熱點。~Relabeling kilowatts per square metre as kilopascals confuses energy rate with force. Even a broad mean dissipation area may contain a concentrated jet, so low average flux cannot exclude a local erosion hotspot.
units.misconception: 每平方公尺耗散功率就是同數值的局部壓力~Dissipated power per area is the same numerical local pressure
units.practice: 把分配面積加倍求平均通量變化，再畫一半功率集中在十分之一面積的情境，計算局部通量並說明平均值何時可能掩蓋集中作用。~Double the assumed distribution area and recalculate mean flux, then concentrate half the power in one tenth of the area. Calculate local flux and explain how a mean can hide concentration.

units.anchor: 近底取水的輸砂效率~Solids concentration in bottom withdrawal
units.title: 近底取水的輸砂效率~Solids concentration in bottom withdrawal
units.mechanism: 靠近底部的取水可能攜帶較濃泥砂，但輸砂效果應用乾固體質量與放流水量共同衡量，而非只說水看起來很濁。質量濃度本身就是每單位水混合物體積攜帶的固體，乘流量才變成質量率。沉積物是否能被帶到入口，還取決於地形與流場，計算輸出不等於證明整個庫底被清除。~Withdrawal near the bottom may carry more concentrated sediment, but performance requires both dry-solids mass and released water volume rather than visual darkness. Concentration measures solids per mixture volume, and multiplication by flow gives mass rate. Whether deposits reach the inlet depends on bed geometry and flow, so a calculated export does not demonstrate clearance of the entire reservoir floor or uniform sediment removal.
units.model: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Q=6 m3/s; C=15 kg/m3; dt=3600 s; M=Q C dt/1000=324 tonne。適用邊界：一小時均勻假想懸浮濃度，非曾文實際設備排砂率或操作條件。~Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Q=6 m3/s; C=15 kg/m3; dt=3600 s; M=Q C dt/1000=324 tonne. Applicable boundary: One hour of uniform hypothetical suspended concentration, not actual Tsengwen equipment performance or operation.
units.verify: 將代表水樣乾燥後求固體濃度，核對採樣口是否避開粗粒沉降而偏低。同步積分放流水量，再以取水前後庫底測量檢查材料來源，區分新入流通過與既有沉積再搬運。~Dry representative samples to determine solids concentration and check whether sampler placement misses settling coarse grains. Integrate released water simultaneously and compare bed surveys to distinguish passage of new incoming sediment from remobilization of previously deposited material.
units.failure: 只以高濃度宣稱效率高可能忽略放流水量很小，總輸出仍有限；反之大量低濃度放流可能耗水多而帶走固體少，兩者需要同一質量與水量邊界才可比較。~High concentration alone may accompany little water and limited total export. A large dilute release may consume much water while carrying few solids; both cases require consistent mass and water boundaries for comparison.
units.misconception: 原水越濁就一定代表該時段排出總泥砂越多~Darker water necessarily means more total sediment was exported during the interval
units.practice: 設另一時段流量加倍但濃度降為三分之一，計算等長時段的輸出質量和用水量，分別比較總輸砂與每單位水的輸砂，不混為同一效率。~Double flow while reducing concentration to one third for an equal duration. Compare total solids, water volume and solids per unit water, keeping those performance measures distinct rather than combining them into one undefined efficiency.

units.anchor: 共同放流的發電與灌溉~Energy and irrigation from one release
units.title: 共同放流的發電與灌溉~Energy and irrigation from one release
units.mechanism: 同一股水可以先經發電再用於灌溉，利用位能不等於把水體消耗掉，因此能源與水量可提供不同服務。帳目應把通過機組的水列為同一次放流，避免再加成第二份供水；實際是否可共用仍受渠道高程、時間和取水位置限制。發電效率影響能量轉換，不直接把相同比例水量變成不可用。~One release may generate electricity before serving irrigation; extracting potential energy does not consume the water itself. The turbine flow therefore remains a single water transfer rather than a second supply allocation. Actual reuse depends on canal elevation, timing and withdrawal location. Conversion efficiency changes electrical output, not the fraction of water physically remaining, so energy and water ledgers must use different units and boundaries.
units.model: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=8 m3/s; H=60 m; eta=0.86; P=rho g Q H eta/1e6=4.049568 MW。適用邊界：同一放流先經假想機組再到下游，未計渠道損失或真實取水配置。~Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=8 m3/s; H=60 m; eta=0.86; P=rho g Q H eta/1e6=4.049568 MW. Applicable boundary: One release passes a hypothetical unit before downstream use, excluding canal losses and actual withdrawal configuration.
units.verify: 在流程圖上用一條水線連接發電與灌溉，另畫能量輸出箭頭，核對單位不混用。比較機組出口及渠道入口累積流量，將中間損失或暫存另外列帳，確認沒有因兩種用途而重複計水。~Draw one water path through generation to irrigation with a separate energy-output arrow, checking units. Compare cumulative turbine-outlet and canal-inlet flows, accounting for intermediate losses or storage so two services do not create duplicate water allocations.
units.failure: 把機組效率低於一解讀成同樣比例水被消耗，會錯估下游可用水；把發電用水與灌溉用水相加成總需求，又可能對同一串聯放流重複扣帳。~Interpreting efficiency below unity as an equal loss of water misstates downstream availability. Adding generation and irrigation water as separate demands can likewise subtract the same serial release twice.
units.misconception: 發電效率八成就表示兩成水量已被機組消耗~Eighty percent generation efficiency means the unit consumes twenty percent of the water
units.practice: 用同一流量求一日通過水量，再計一日發電量，將兩者以各自單位並列。若渠道另損失百分之五，只修改下游水量帳並說明是否改變已發出的電。~Calculate daily water throughput and energy at the same flow, displaying their distinct units. Apply a separate five-percent canal loss only to downstream water and explain whether it changes electricity already generated.

units.anchor: 灌溉明渠的曼寧尺度~Manning scale for an irrigation canal
units.title: 灌溉明渠的曼寧尺度~Manning scale for an irrigation canal
units.mechanism: 開放渠道的平均流速受斷面形狀、濕周、坡度及粗糙阻力共同控制。矩形斷面水力半徑是面積除濕周，不等於水深，尤其窄渠道差異顯著。曼寧式可估算均勻流通水量，但回水、閘門控制或急變流會破壞水面坡與底坡近似相同的條件，需要另作水面線分析。~Mean open-channel velocity depends on geometry, wetted perimeter, slope and roughness. For a rectangular section, hydraulic radius is area divided by wetted perimeter, not simply depth, especially in a narrow canal. Manning's relation estimates uniform-flow capacity, while backwater, gates or rapidly varied flow can invalidate the approximation that energy slope follows bed slope and require a water-surface-profile calculation instead.
units.model: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：b=5 m; y=1.2 m; n=0.025 s/m^(1/3); S=0.0004; A=by=6 m2; R=A/(b+2y); Q=A R^(2/3)sqrt(S)/n=4.173697 m3/s。適用邊界：國際單位制曼寧式、棱柱矩形渠均勻流，糙率為假想值。~Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: b=5 m; y=1.2 m; n=0.025 s/m^(1/3); S=0.0004; A=by=6 m2; R=A/(b+2y); Q=A R^(2/3)sqrt(S)/n=4.173697 m3/s. Applicable boundary: SI Manning relation for uniform flow in a prismatic rectangular canal, with assumed roughness.
units.verify: 由實測斷面計算面積與濕周，確認側壁也納入濕周；以沿程水面高程檢查是否近似均勻流。比較量得流量與不同糙率結果，保留植物、沉積與維護狀態，不把糙率當永久固定常數。~Calculate area and wetted perimeter from a surveyed section including both sidewalls, and inspect longitudinal water levels for near-uniform flow. Compare measured discharge across plausible roughness values while documenting vegetation, deposits and maintenance rather than treating roughness as permanently fixed.
units.failure: 直接把水深當水力半徑會高估窄渠通量；若下游閘門回水卻仍採底坡為能量坡，則可能得到不符合現地水面線的流量，連帶錯估供水能力。~Replacing hydraulic radius with depth overstates narrow-channel flow. Using bed slope as energy slope under downstream backwater can produce a discharge inconsistent with the observed water surface and misstate delivery capacity.
units.misconception: 矩形渠道的水力半徑永遠等於水深~Hydraulic radius of a rectangular canal always equals its depth
units.practice: 把渠道糙率增至零點零三，保持幾何與坡度重算流量，再比較擴寬一公尺的結果，說明兩種改善或劣化不能只用斷面面積判斷。~Raise roughness to zero point zero three at fixed geometry and slope, then compare with widening the canal by one metre. Explain why area alone cannot characterize either change in conveyance.

units.anchor: 壩頂沉陷的速率解讀~Interpreting crest settlement rate
units.title: 壩頂沉陷的速率解讀~Interpreting crest settlement rate
units.mechanism: 土石壩壩頂高程隨施工後壓密、材料蠕變、水位及量測基準而改變，兩次高程差除時間只給平均沉陷速率。這個速率不代表未來必然維持直線，也不能單靠向下或向上判斷原因。比較不同測點的空間形狀和時間曲線，通常比單一點的總沉陷量更能辨識差異變形與儀器問題。~Crest elevation can change through consolidation, creep, reservoir cycles and reference movement. Dividing the difference between two surveys by elapsed time gives only an average settlement rate, not a guaranteed future linear trend or a diagnosis from movement direction alone. Spatial patterns across several points and the shape of the time history are often more informative than one accumulated displacement for distinguishing differential deformation from measurement problems.
units.model: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：settlement1=12 mm; settlement2=21 mm; dt=180 day; rate=(21-12)/dt=0.05 mm/day。適用邊界：沉陷向下為正、兩次測量共用穩定基準，僅時段平均速率。~Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: settlement1=12 mm; settlement2=21 mm; dt=180 day; rate=(21-12)/dt=0.05 mm/day. Applicable boundary: Downward settlement is positive and both surveys share a stable datum; interval-average rate only.
units.verify: 以閉合水準測量核對基準穩定，將同日庫水位、氣溫與儀器變更標在沉陷圖上。比較多個壩頂點的差異沉陷，並用至少三個時段查看速率是否加快，避免兩點直線掩蓋曲線轉折。~Close the leveling survey against stable references and annotate reservoir level, temperature and instrument changes. Compare differential settlement across crest points and examine at least three intervals for acceleration, rather than letting a two-point straight line conceal curvature in the trend.
units.failure: 用兩次量測直接外推多年會忽略蠕變速率改變；基準點下沉可能讓壩頂看似上升，若未檢查閉合誤差與外部參考，便可能把量測網變動誤判為壩體回彈。~Extrapolating years from two observations ignores changing creep rate. A settling reference can make the crest appear to rise, so absent network closure and external checks, reference motion may be mistaken for structural rebound.
units.misconception: 兩次量測求出的平均沉陷速率必定可永久線性外推~An average settlement rate from two surveys can always be extrapolated indefinitely
units.practice: 增加第三次測量，假設再過一百八十日只增加三毫米，計算兩段速率並畫累積曲線，說明平均值相同或不同時仍需查看空間差異。~Add a third survey after another one hundred eighty days with only three millimetres of additional settlement. Compare interval rates and cumulative curves, explaining why spatial differences still matter alongside averaged trends.

units.anchor: 田間淨需水與毛取水~Net field need and gross withdrawal
units.title: 田間淨需水與毛取水~Net field need and gross withdrawal
units.mechanism: 灌溉淨需水深度乘田區面積得到作物端水量，除以整體輸配效率才得到水源端毛需求。效率是同一邊界下有用水與取水的比值，若已涵蓋渠道損失，就不能再扣一次。不同作物、降雨及回歸水會改變真正需求，這個固定深度例子只用來練習單位與邊界，不代表實際配水規則。~Net irrigation depth times field area gives water needed at the crop boundary, while division by delivery efficiency gives gross source withdrawal. Efficiency must refer to consistent boundaries; canal losses included in it cannot be deducted again. Crop choice, rainfall and return flows alter real demand, so this fixed-depth exercise teaches units and accounting rather than prescribing allocation or representing a measured seasonal irrigation requirement.
units.model: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：depth=0.6 m; area=200 ha=2000000 m2; eta=0.75; Vgross=depth area/eta=1600000 m3。適用邊界：淨深度已扣有效降雨，效率含假想輸配損失，不再重複扣減。~Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: depth=0.6 m; area=200 ha=2000000 m2; eta=0.75; Vgross=depth area/eta=1600000 m3. Applicable boundary: Net depth already excludes effective rainfall and efficiency includes assumed conveyance losses, with no second deduction.
units.verify: 先將公頃換成平方公尺、毫米換成公尺，再分別列淨需水與毛取水，核對效率分子分母。以渠道入流及田間供水比較估計效率時，要對齊時段並考慮暫存，不能把回歸水直接當完全損失。~Convert hectares to square metres and millimetres to metres, then list net need and gross withdrawal separately with explicit efficiency boundaries. When comparing canal input and field delivery, align periods and account for storage rather than treating all return flow as irrecoverable loss.
units.failure: 以淨需水乘效率會把水源需求算得比田間需求還小；若先除效率又再加同一渠道損失，則重複放大需求，導致不同方案比較只是帳目定義不同而非真正節水。~Multiplying net need by efficiency makes source demand smaller than field need. Dividing by efficiency and then adding the same canal loss inflates demand twice, making apparent savings depend on inconsistent accounting rather than physical improvement.
units.misconception: 毛取水量應把田間淨需水乘上輸配效率~Gross withdrawal equals net field requirement multiplied by delivery efficiency
units.practice: 把效率提高到零點八五，計算毛取水減少量與比例，再指出是否能把所有減少量都當流域新水資源，並討論原本回歸水可能已有下游用途。~Increase efficiency to zero point eight five and calculate gross-withdrawal reduction. Explain why all of that reduction may not become new basin supply when previous return flows already supported downstream uses.
